messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "dose increases after several more weeks if there is a lack of clinical improvement for lower-weight children"
set: ["dose increases after several more weeks if there is a lack of clinical improvement for lower-weight children", "may increase dose after several weeks if there is lack of clinical improvement", "additional dose increases after several more weeks if insufficient clinical improvement", "doctor may increase dose after several weeks if needed", "doctor may adjust dose after several weeks if needed for panic disorder", "increase dose if symptoms have not improved after several weeks", "several weeks", "dose increases should be based on clinical response", "tapering dose is required after more than a few days", "children tested 2 weeks after any dose change", "this lack of control is especially true at a 100 mg dose", "after dose is lowered", "4 weeks after each dose change", "tell your doctor if side effects last for more than a few weeks", "may take several weeks before you notice a difference", "take regularly over several weeks for full pain-relieving effect"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
